subject: general
question: The ocean bodies and the sea contain ______ water.
solution:
The correct answer is __**salty**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ocean bodies and the sea contain **salty **water.
 
• The water of the oceans is salty or saline as it contains** large amount of dissolved salts.**
 
• Most of the salt is sodium chloride or the common **table salt that we eat.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ocean covers more than **70 percent of the surface of our planet.**
 
• About **97 percent of the Earth's water** can be found in our ocean.
 
• About two percent is frozen up in glaciers and ice caps.
 
• Less than one percent of all the water on** Earth is fresh.**
 
• A tiny fraction of water exists as **water vapor in our atmosphere.**
